item.text: {"counterevidence":["The capacity snapshot is for gas day 2026-08-30, while the listed maintenance begins on or after 2026-08-31; it does not demonstrate conditions during the planned work.","For several matched segments, the opposite capacity-flow direction has zero scheduled quantity or substantial available capacity. Net scheduled quantity is directional and is not a measure of all underlying nominations.","The quality gate is warning-level: it flags notice-index reconciliation issues, operator reduction inconsistencies, one historical source-clock regression, one or more available-capacity reconciliation differences, and seven unprocessed archived artifacts.","No basis prices, Henry Hub prices, physical-flow measurements, storage, weather, production, or futures data are included."],"facts":[{"claim":"TGP notice 403802, updated August 27, reports planned operational-capacity changes beginning August 31 and extending through November 29. It can be zero in the opposite displayed direction even where nominations exist.","term":"Net scheduled quantity"}],"headline":"TGP has a sizable planned-maintenance schedule beginning August 31; the pre-maintenance capacity snapshot highlights segments to monitor, not an established market impact.","missing_data":["A refreshed capacity snapshot during each planned maintenance window, including any revised notice version.","Measured physical flows and nominations by relevant receipt and delivery locations.","Regional cash-basis observations and a time-aligned benchmark price, with availability timestamps no later than the decision time.","Relevant downstream demand, storage, weather, production, and alternative-route capacity data.","Confirmation of the affected path and commercial participants; the packet supplies segment-level matching only.","Resolution or verification of the warning-level quality-gate findings."],"overall_confidence":"medium","plain_english_summary":"TGP's August 27 notice describes planned maintenance from August 31 into late November, including reported reductions as large as 868,000 Dth/day. The August 30 capacity snapshot is timely rather than stale, but it precedes the work. It identifies segments that could become operationally important if capacity is reduced while scheduled demand remains high. It does not show physical flows or support a price forecast or trade recommendation.","watch_items":[{"confidence":"medium","confirmation_needed":["A capacity update and notice revision covering the August 31–October 25 work period.","Measured flows or updated net schedules showing that the affected TD2 path remains constrained during the work.","Pricing and alternative-route data to assess any transport or basis consequence."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"],"invalidation":["The planned work is cancelled, deferred, or its reported reduction is materially lowered.","A current capacity snapshot shows adequate available transport capacity or lower scheduled demand on the relevant path.","Measured flows reroute without congestion or price data show no associated basis response."],"market_channel":"transport","scenario":"If the reported segment 548 maintenance is implemented and current-path demand remains near the operational capacity indicator, shippers may have less transport flexibility on the affected route. This is a conditional transport-congestion scenario, not evidence of physical-flow loss or a price direction.","title":"Monitor segment 548 during planned maintenance"},{"confidence":"medium","confirmation_needed":["A segment 530 capacity update during the August 31–October 18 maintenance period.","Current schedules and measured flows for the relevant path, plus alternate-path availability.","Time-aligned regional basis and benchmark prices, with point-in-time availability, before assessing a basis setup."],"evidence_ids":["km_tgp_notice_detail:1787932505364330000:46485bb248300193468625e90e1a0552f36c4adb8a4d2cdff1a507c289e82063","km_tgp_segment_capacity:1788105216817246000:a4457f5a9ca6180e2bb5e83f4fab842ac9a9ac3f88e3d9819ba77215daf9490d"],"invalidation":["The segment 530 work is revised, deferred, or cancelled.","Updated operating and available capacity remain sufficient for current schedules.","No corroborating constraints appear in physical flows, alternate routes, or regional price data."],"market_channel":"upstream-basis","scenario":"If the reported segment 530 reduction takes effect and limits transport away from upstream supply relative to demand for that route, an upstream-basis pressure scenario could develop. The packet does not establish geography, actual flow, or a basis-price outcome.","title":"Monitor segment 530 for conditional upstream-basis pressure"}],"why_it_matters":"Planned maintenance can matter when a route is already using much of its reported operational capacity. Here, the relevant capacity snapshot predates the work and the source has warning-level data-quality findings, so the appropriate action is to monitor updated notices, capacity, physical flows, and time-aligned prices rather than infer a trade."}
